headline: Sources: Caleb Williams injury considered to have 3-4 week timeline
summary: Bears quarterback Caleb Williams has a Grade 2 hamstring injury that doctors say could sideline him for three to four weeks, league sources told ESPN and NFL Network.

headline: Sources: Myles Garrett faces 6-week timeline from knee surgery
summary: Myles Garrett was given a six-week recovery timeline from his knee surgery, meaning the star pass rusher might not return until early November, sources told NFL Network.

headline: Broncos place RB Jonah Coleman (ankle) on IR
summary: Denver Broncos rookie running back Jonah Coleman was placed on injured reserve Saturday with an ankle injury he suffered in the team's Week 2 win over the Jacksonville Jaguars.

headline: Giants set game plan with Jameis Winston, mull options to add QB
summary: The Giants' pursuit of a veteran quarterback will depend on how well Jameis Winston performs against the Titans in Week 3.

headline: Commanders QB Jayden Daniels Could Return Sooner Than Expected

headline: Sources: Cowboys, Lions make trade inquiries on Joey Porter Jr.
summary: A handful of teams, including the Cowboys and Lions, have begun making inquiries about the availability of Steelers cornerback Joey Porter Jr., sources told ESPN.
